faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Toronto at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: Do neighbourhood pages actually help in Toronto?
faqs.a: Yes. Homeowners in Toronto often search with a neighbourhood or district attached, from Riverdale to North York, so distinct pages for the areas you serve help you appear for those more specific searches.

faqs.q: Does Ontario regulation affect my Toronto page?
faqs.a: It can. Rules about titles and advertising vary by profession and province, so your content should use only the claims and credentials you are entitled to make in Ontario.
